round_purpose: Post-A0H20 algorithm efficiency study. A0I-A = frozen-label offline adaptivity diagnostics (CPU only). A0I-B = scalar directional scoring feasibility on pre-existing dev states (dev-only, no acceptance identity). This is an algorithm-engineering round, NOT a new independent utility acceptance.

frozen_science_semantics.predicted_delta_loss_j: lambda*hhat_j; h_0 = 0; no-op is a legal action
frozen_science_semantics.selected_id: min(action_ids, key=(predicted_delta_loss_j, action_id)); exact tie lowest id; common positive lambda does not change ranking
frozen_science_semantics.action_injection: post-unscale/pre-clip, one optimizer step g' = g + lambda*(g_j - g) at h=1
frozen_science_semantics.score_direction: h_j = <w_0, g_j - g> where w_0 is the shared FP32-HVP adjoint direction (candidate-independent)
frozen_science_semantics.directional_identity_under_test: h_j = D_theta L_j(theta_decision)[w_0] - w_0^T g, w_0 fixed (no derivative of w_0)

a0i_a_scope.data: A0H20 frozen 12-unit five-action labels only (predictions + labels/score + labels/eval + analysis/analysis.json)
a0i_a_scope.label_mutation: NONE - diagnostics read labels, never rewrite them

frozen_references.task_utility: A0H20 mean Gain_eval = +1.467e-4, per-seed 5/6 positive, harmful 1/12 (FROZEN, cited only, never renamed)
frozen_references.oracle_diagnostic: oracle_eval_mean_gain ~ 2.345e-4, capture ~ 62.6% (empirical finite-candidate oracle diagnostic, batch-local)

a0i_b_scope.dev_states_source: frozen a0g DEV_STATES (pre-existing dev, never exposed to acceptance)
streams: stream_id 0 per state (budget first; extend only if budget remains)
a0i_b_scope.a0h20_acceptance_units: EXPOSED - any use demoted to debug/dev, never reused for independent utility claims
a0i_b_scope.state_selection: fixed by frozen DEV_STATES; NO cherry-picking by directional-scoring performance
a0i_b_scope.w_0_source: shared FP32-HVP adjoint computed by the frozen production path (run_adjoint_only semantics) at the same dev state/stream
a0i_b_scope.reference_scorer_METHOD_A: frozen _grad_on_batches full candidate gradients + project_tangent(w_0, g_j - g), ambient backend (production semantics)
a0i_b_scope.method_B: per-candidate scalar JVP: h_j = sum_micro jvp(loss_micro, theta_tangent=w_0)/accum - w_0^T g; torch.func.functional_call + torch.func.jvp; w fixed tangent; RNG capture/restore per candidate; autocast bf16 same as reference
a0i_b_scope.method_C: attempted ONLY if candidates share a reusable common pool with known weights; group disjointness verified offline; expected NOT_APPLICABLE (disjoint hash groups -> no amortization)
a0i_b_scope.unsupported_handling: if forward-mode AD is unsupported for a key op: minimal repro + error saved; UNSUPPORTED_IN_CURRENT_BACKEND is a legal verdict; NO silent model/backend/loss change to force equivalence

numerical_gate_prefixed.note: thresholds are PRE-FIXED engineering references written before seeing A0I-B results; copied from the frozen A0H20/B1 FP32 gate (atol32=1e-5, rtol32=1e-4). Raw errors are reported regardless of pass/fail; NO threshold may be adjusted after viewing results.
numerical_gate_prefixed.scope: per state/stream/action vs METHOD A reference (fp32hvp_adjoint production scores)
numerical_gate_prefixed.decision_preservation: 5-action ranking agreement AND chosen_id equality vs production fp32adj_argmin, per unit
numerical_gate_prefixed.finite_check: all scores finite else NON_FINITE blocked
numerical_gate_prefixed.claim_limit: tolerance pass means implementation agreement only, NOT native-derivative correctness

benchmark_protocol_prefixed.device: cuda:0 under CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 (physical GPU1; shared with external jobs, occupancy recorded)
benchmark_protocol_prefixed.interleaving: per repeat: shared prefix once (restore -> rollout+snapshots -> endpoint grad -> shared reverse adjoint -> w_0), then scoring stages with order alternating per repeat (even rep: METHOD A then METHOD B; odd rep: reversed); selected-gradient recompute and native-step reference timed every repeat
benchmark_protocol_prefixed.timing_method: CUDA events + wall perf_counter, torch.cuda.synchronize, reset_peak_memory_stats per stage
benchmark_protocol_prefixed.per_candidate_timing: per-candidate scoring timed inside all-M stage (M=1,2,4 prefixes allowed for TIMING ONLY, not new science candidates)
benchmark_protocol_prefixed.memory: peak allocated + peak reserved per stage, reset between stages
benchmark_protocol_prefixed.marginal_cost_model: T(M) = a + bM least squares over M=1,2,4; labeled LOCAL_AFFINE_DIAGNOSTIC; NOT a scaling law
benchmark_protocol_prefixed.report: raw per-repeat records + medians; equivalent_native_steps = total_decision_cost / native_step_time (engineering metric, NOT closed-loop overhead)

forbidden_this_round: new training seeds or long training
reclaiming A0H20 exposed data as independent validation
calling tolerance pass an engineering success without wall-clock/memory evidence
